# Adversarial Robustness Lab

> Evasion attacks, adversarial training and randomized smoothing certification for CIFAR-10 classifiers, measured on the full test set.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab

## Source

- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/__init__.py): Adversarial Robustness Lab - package root.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/__init__.py): Evasion attacks: FGSM, PGD (L-infinity and L2), C&W L2, APGD, APGD-T, Square, ensembles.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/apgd.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/apgd.py): Auto-PGD: APGD-CE, APGD-DLR and targeted APGD-T (Croce and Hein, 2020).
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/autoattack.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/autoattack.py): An AutoAttack-style ensemble: run attacks in sequence on the points still robust.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/base.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/base.py): Common interface for evasion attacks.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/cw.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/cw.py): Carlini-Wagner L2 attack (Carlini and Wagner, 2017).
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/geometry.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/geometry.py): Threat-model geometry shared by every attack: norms, projections and random starts.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/losses.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/losses.py): Objective functions maximized by the attacks, all returned per sample.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/pgd.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/pgd.py): Gradient attacks with a fixed step: FGSM and projected gradient descent (PGD).
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/square.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/attacks/square.py): Square attack, L-infinity (Andriushchenko et al., 2020): a score-based black-box attack.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/cli.py): Command line: ``python -m adversarial_robustness_lab <command>``.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/data.py): CIFAR-10 loading, caching and on-device augmentation.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/evaluation.py): Robust accuracy evaluation with threat-model verification.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/masking.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/masking.py): A deliberately gradient-masking defense, and the adaptive attack that breaks it.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/models.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/models.py): Classifiers for CIFAR-10: PreAct ResNet-18, WideResNet and a small CNN.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/runtime.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/runtime.py): Device selection, seeding, memory limits and checkpoints.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/sanity.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/sanity.py): Gradient-masking sanity checks (Athalye et al., 2018; Carlini et al., 2019).
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/service.py): HTTP service: classify, attack and certify CIFAR-10 images with a trained checkpoint.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/smoothing.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/smoothing.py): Randomized smoothing certification (Cohen, Rosenfeld and Kolter, ICML 2019).
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/stats.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/stats.py): Statistics for robustness claims: exact binomial tools and confidence intervals.
- [src/adversarial_robustness_lab/training.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/adversarial-robustness-lab/blob/main/src/adversarial_robustness_lab/training.py): Training: standard, PGD adversarial training, TRADES, fast FGSM training and noise.
